item.title: “There is Money Everywhere,” Says The Lawyer Who Makes Money By Not Practicing Law
item.description: Davida Opara has a first-class law degree but she has never practiced law. The interesting thing is that she's making more money than she would in a regular law firm. Here's how she's building multiple income streams while doing purpose-driven work.

item.title: Sunken Ships: I Didn’t Want To Do Fraud
item.description: What do you do when the people you thought you could rely on taunt you when you’re vulnerable? In this Sunken Ships, Demola* (26) shares how painful mockery from his friends made him abandon a friendship he thought would last forever.

item.title: #NairaLife: This Video Editor Considers Herself a Recovering Spendthrift
item.description: The 27-year-old in this #NairaLife spent years juggling multiple jobs before landing on a career path that works. With the uncertainty out of the way, she can now focus on something that has been a major concern: her financial habits.

item.title: Q5 Party: A New Shared Celebration for Forward-Thinking Organisations
item.description: Q5 party offers companies a simple yet premium way to celebrate their teams without the logistics and pressure of planning an independent year-end party.

item.title: How Financially Savvy Are You?
item.description: Think you’re good with money? Take this quick quiz to find out what your spending habits say about you.

item.title: He Agreed to an Open Relationship Until I Kissed a Man
item.description: Adanna thought an open relationship would ease the distance until Daniel reacted differently to her kissing a man.

item.title: 8 Nigerian Historical Events that Deserve Movie Adaptations
item.description: The appetite for authentic Nigerian narratives is immense. This pop piece highlights 8 Nigerian historical events that offer compelling, cinematic material for adaptation.

item.title: On the Streets: I Rushed Into A Marriage And Got Divorced at 24
item.description: "I was hospitalised for months, but my husband only visited twice." Ummi* (28) married young, survived a turbulent partnership, and has spent the last few years trying, and failing, to find her person. In this story, she talks about her dating experiences and the lessons they’ve taught her.

item.title: 7 Reasons Why Red Bull ‘Spin It Loud’ Is the Wildest DJ Showdown in Lagos
item.description: Lagos, if you’re looking for that one event to kickstart Detty December with pure energy, this is it. One theme. One mix. One unforgettable night. See you at SOL Beach.

item.title: Love Currency: “He Tries His Best, but I Often Feel Financially Stressed”
item.description: Patience* (27) and David* (35) got married five months after they met in 2020. For #LoveCurrency, Patience discusses her initial reluctance to marry a pastor, the impact of constant giving on their finances, and how she copes with it.
